questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of Azure Policy?

options.label: A
options.text: Enforce compliance and governance across resources

questions.explanation: Azure Policy evaluates resource properties against defined rules to enforce compliance and governance.

questions.question_text: Which Azure feature allows you to lock a resource to prevent accidental deletion or modification?
questions.explanation: Resource locks (CanNotDelete or ReadOnly) protect resources from being deleted or altered.

questions.question_text: How do tags help with cost management in Azure?

options.label: B
options.text: By grouping resources for reporting and cost allocation

questions.explanation: Tags enable grouping and categorization of resources, making cost analysis and allocation easier.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a recommended practice for organizing resources into resource groups?

options.label: A
options.text: Group by application lifecycle (dev, test, prod)

options.label: B
options.text: Group by department or business unit

options.label: C
options.text: Use a single group for all resources

questions.explanation: A single group defeats the purpose of segmentation, hindering management, access control, and cost tracking.

questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of Management Groups in Azure?

options.label: A
options.text: Enforce Azure Policy across multiple subscriptions

questions.explanation: Management Groups provide a hierarchical scope to apply governance, such as Azure Policy, across many subscriptions.

questions.question_text: Which Azure service provides recommendations for cost optimization?
questions.explanation: Azure Advisor analyzes usage and offers actionable recommendations to reduce costs.

questions.question_text: To restrict the creation of new resources in a subscription, which Azure feature should you use?
questions.explanation: Azure Policy can deny or audit the creation of resources, effectively restricting what can be deployed.

questions.question_text: What is the effect of applying a 'ReadOnly' resource lock?
questions.explanation: A ReadOnly lock blocks any write operations, including updates and deletions, on the locked resource.

questions.question_text: Which statement about Azure subscriptions is true?

options.label: A
options.text: All resources must belong to a management group

options.label: B
options.text: A subscription can have multiple resource groups

options.label: C
options.text: Subscriptions cannot be linked to multiple management groups

options.label: D
options.text: Subscriptions are only used for billing, not governance

questions.explanation: A subscription can contain many resource groups, which help organize resources within that subscription.

questions.question_text: How do you assign a tag to multiple resources at once?
questions.explanation: The Azure portal provides a bulk edit feature that lets you apply the same tag to several resources simultaneously.
